source_statement: The participating hospitals supplied U-TEG MA values and voltage recordings, together with the corresponding instrument-exported TEG readouts.
runtime_input: U-TEG inputs are indexed on a 900-point grid at one-second intervals (15 minutes). The 5- and 10-minute windows cover the first 300 and 600 grid points. Processing masks identify the points retained for fitting. The runner loads saved early fits and stored full-record coefficients; parameter preparation precedes model evaluation.
